prompt:
A single small game icon, painted in a rustic 1990s hand-painted trading-card style (gouache and ink, muted antique colours, matte, slightly worn), with a bold, simple silhouette that still reads at 16 pixels. Centred with generous empty margin, on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no badge or circle behind it, no drop shadow.

Subject: The Offering coin: a single worn Chinese bronze cash coin with a square hole, seen perfectly straight-on, filling the frame, tarnished with green patina, small nicks and grime, a faint low-relief skull struck beside the square hole. Matte, painted like the weathered frames of an old trading card; no shine, no text, no characters, no numbers. Chinese, Journey to the West style, colourful.
